text.text_excerpt: I loved the Pho I had at Nola for Life. It's located inside the French Market and they have some bar stools you can sit at. I ordered the Pho which had everything already in it (ie the jalapeño, the lime, etc). The broth was not too rich, but it was salty and flavorful. I was suffering from a terrible hangover and it fixed me right up. The people working here are SO nice- and they were always checking on me (and making sure I was enjoying myself). If you like pho- go here!

Easily some of the best pho I've ever had; and my pho-fu is pretty incredible. The difference between this pho and others? You don't feel like shit after eating it. Why? Because you can't see the grease separate from the other liquids in the broth. Everything is very fresh and so non-greasy that it goes down as a very light lunch. They only have one kind of pho (beef), a beef bun and pork bahn mi so it's not very veggie friendly (sorry, guys). The only downside is that it's outside, like everything else in the market so there's no AC; and that it's cash only, also like everything else in the market. Unphogettable Pho Sho! The only thing better than a pho pun is pho itself, and I'll admit it was the groovy name that drew me in. I'm so very glad it did, as it ended up being one of my favorite meals of the trip. The pho was completely authentic and flavored to perfection and the mother daughter duo running the place could not have been more delightful. I was worried that it may have been too hot at the outdoor market to sit and eat comfortably, but once I dug in I completely forgot about the sweat that was dripping down my back.
